changes.sourceChinese: 皝以段遼屢為邊患，遣將軍宋回稱籓于石季龍，請師討遼。
changes.before: Troubled by Duan Liao, he sent Song Hui to submit to Shi Hu and beg for an allied expedition.
changes.after: Because Duan Liao repeatedly troubled his borders, Huang sent General Song Hui to Shi Hu to declare Huang’s vassalage and request troops to attack Duan Liao.
changes.reason: Restore repeated border trouble, the general title and the specific request for troops; name Huang explicitly to avoid attributing his vassalage to the envoy.

changes.before: After a fortnight’s siege his officers begged him to yield.
changes.after: After the two sides held each other off for more than ten days, his attendants urged Huang to surrender.
changes.reason: Render 旬餘 as more than ten days, 左右 as attendants, and make Huang the explicit recipient of their advice.
